title: Willerton crossing-number bound for the degree-three Vassiliev invariant
exact_claim: For every classical knot K and every diagram with n crossings, |v3(K)| <= floor(n(n^2-1)/24), with v3 the additive mirror-odd degree-three invariant taking value 1 on the right trefoil.
source: Ohtsuki (ed.), Problems on invariants of knots and 3-manifolds (2002), Section 2.4 pp.403-405, Conjecture 2.11; complete pinned record and prior report read.
